title: Reading Drill — Surveying moths near lighting — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Surveying moths near lighting — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The ecology club in Millcross received an old report about moths gathering near brightly lit shop windows. The report compared the number of moths per visit, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the standard observation sheets rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered five weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include overnight rainfall. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed shields on exterior lamps as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
